verdict.rationale: RudderStack Profiles resolves identities into a warehouse customer 360. It generates identity graphs from any combination of unique identifiers across any number of sources, and rules are configurable: entities and their attributes are declared in version-controlled YAML that compiles to warehouse-native SQL handling identity resolution. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of anonymous-to-known (anonymousId-to-userId) stitching and cross-device merging, detail on the specific match/merge rule options, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
